My portfolio includes eight digital projects across SaaS, food marketplaces, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, agriculture and B2B commerce. I use Figma and Framer for UI/UX design and draw visual inspiration from Dribbble. Separately, I have knowledge of n8n, marketing automation, SQL and Power BI for workflow automation, analysis and reporting. I focus on clear, practical digital experiences and continue developing skills across design and technology.
